description: Dynamic attributes processing of what partial processing leaves of a body array is an error
notes: The spec says partial processing gives a new body of the remaining elements, and that dynamic attributes processing needs a single JSON object, but not whether the body left from an array is one. hashicorp/hcl's remaining body wraps the same array ((*body).PartialContent in json/structure.go), and its dynamic attributes processing requires an object ((*body).JustAttributes), so it fails.
reference_error: A JSON object is required here, setting the arguments for this block
